tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa "$ zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ gang gis shes bya kun gzigs nas// dam pa'i chos kyi seng ge'i sgras// mu stegs thams cad 'joms mdzad pa'i// go taṃ de la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas de sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs// snying gi padmor spyan drangs nas// mkhas rnams dga' byed dag pa'i rtsis// nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag brtsam// bskal pa bzang po'i ya thog kun// dus bzhi chen por bzhag pa de'i// rtsod pa'i dus la ston pa byon// 'khrungs lo mig dmar brgyad cur bzhugs// don dgu'i nag nyar 'bras spungs su// zla ba bzang pos gsol btab ngor// dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam par phye// mi bdag nges bsdus 'grel pa mdzad// blos bslangs bzhengs shing lo gnyis bshad// phyi ma'i rgyal nyar sras bkod nas// rang nyid gang nas byon der song*// thub pa'i 'das lo de kho na// de sras lha dbang gzi brjid can// zla bas byin dang lha'i dbang phyug /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha'i dbang ldan// rnams kyi lo brgyar bstan drug brgya// de nas smra ba'i seng ge'i dus// lo brgya de yi go dgu'i bar// de bshad brgya par rigs kun gcig /mdzad pas phyin chad rigs ldan te// dus der nyi ma'i shing rta'i ngor// dpal ldan rgyud bsdus 'grel byed pa// de sras pad dkar de lo bskos// bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang*// phyag dmar khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*// nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang*// rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' dang*// nyi ma sna tshogs gzugs zla 'ong*// mtha' yas sa skyong dpal skyong dang*// seng ge rnam gnon stobs chen dang*// ma 'gags mi seng dbang phyug che// mtha' yas rnam rgyal gdan gyi mthar// 'jam dbyangs grags pa slar byon pa// mi bdag drag po 'khor lo bsgyur// zla bzang min pas brgya brgyar bstan// bdun dang nyer drug chos rgyal grangs// de phyir grags pa'i dus the pa'i// brgyad brgya'i phyi lo ma kha'i yul// kla klo sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis// rahma ṇa yi lugs ngan brtsams// byed pa'i rtsis dar grub mtha' nyams// grags pa'i dus rdzogs nas brgyad brgyar// kla klo'i lugs 'phel 'phags yul sleb// rgya mtsho rnams rgyal chos bstan tshugs// me mkha' rgya mtsho'i rtsis 'go zug

/nyi sgrol byed kyi de lo nas// brgya dang gya gnyis rgyal dka'i dus// dpal ldan rgyud rtsis dag 'di bcos// de nas nyis brgya nyer gcig song*// zang byed lo nang dus 'khor lo// rgya gar chos kyi gling du phebs// de phyi'i rab byung nas da lta'i// na tshod ldan tshun drug cu skor// dgu dang lo brgyad khrir rnam gnon// kla klo'i gnas tshad stong brgyad brgya// 'dir zhugs nas brtsams mtha' ma'i bar// de yi mtha' ma'i brgya pa'i nang*// byed pa'i blo gros 'joms pa yin// 'joms byed drag pos lnga bcu'i ring*// sham bha lar bstan nga gcig par// lho phyogs sog yul mtshams su 'thabs// de thul g.yas skor gling rnams kyang*// 'dul bar lo ni zhe brgyad 'gor// brgya par kun thul slar log pa// de lor tshangs pa 'di dang gzhan// lha dbang bkod gshegs yab nyid ni// 'khor lo can dang sras byed can// tsha man dum bu can du bzhed// sangs rgyas 'khrungs nas 'di thug la// bstan pa'i dus bzhi legs par phye// lo grangs sum stong nyis brgya dang*// brgyad cur bdag gi bla ma gsung*// rgyal po'i mdun gyi rtsod dus de'i// tshangs pas chos bstan rgyal po'i rgyab// 'di nas dus bzhi chung ngu yi// lo grangs nyi khri chig stong dang*// drug brgya re re lnga stong dang*// bzhi brgya gsil tshun bstan pa gnas// chung ngu'i rtsod dus brgyas rdzogs te// tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'grib// des ni yar gyi ya thog rdzogs// gnas tshad bstan pa'i rnam gzhag gzhan// dgongs pa can dang 'di ji bzhin// bstan pa'i 'das lo mang po kun// thams cad chu shing lta bu'o// zhes rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa las gtan tshigs bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa dang po'o// // go la sgang gshongs zlum skor sogs// bsgyur las thad bzhag don bzang nas// sgyur byed kun gyis de kar bzhag

/spyi dang gnam sa'i dbye ba gsum// sna tshogs las kyis bris pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams dbyibs rnam pa mang*// de bas 'dis 'dul rang snang dang*// mthun pa 'jig rten khams ler bstan// mkha' la rlung me chu'i dkyil 'khor// maṇḍal steng 'og bsgyur 'dra gsum// gcig nang gcig chud de nang sa// kun tu srab mthug dpag tshad ni// re rer stong phrag lnga bcu yod// rlung gi phyi rngams 'bum phrag gnyis// chu gcig gnyis ka mnyam zhing me// gnyis las stong phrag bdun cu dang*// lnga 'phags de ni rdo rje'i ri// de nang chu dang de nang sa'i// stong phrag nyer lnga khor yug skor// de nyid bcu gnyis bcad pa'i dbus// lus 'phags 'dzam gling ba lang spyod// sgra mi snyan dang gling g.yog brgyad// shar zlum lho phyogs zur gsum pa// byang ni zla gam nub gru bzhi// 'bur po gzhan cho rgyal chen gyi// pus nub tsam pas khyab de gang*// 'khor lo sgyur 'byung dus na bri// phan tshun khor yug de nas 'gro// de nas bsil ri de rtse dang*// ri rab bang rim phyi ma 'byar// gangs ri dpag tshad stong phrag ni// brgyad cu rtsa drug gyen du'o// de nang chang mtsho drag po'i gling*// rim pa de yi dro ṇa dang*// chu dang khrung khrung nor bu'i 'od// 'o ma mi 'am ci ṣa ṭa// zho dang ku sha mandū ra// mar dang 'od dkar 'od sngon ri// sbrang rtsi'i mtsho dang zla ba'i gling*// kun brgya dpag tshad brgyad brgya dang*// gya brgyad rgyang grags gsum dang 'dom// stong brgya bcu gcig sor mo bcu// nas lnga gsum char mnyam pa yin// rdo rje'i ri las bsil ri bzhin// phyi las nang ma'i ri kun 'phags// des mtshungs mtsho gling dag kyang ngo*// de nas rgyar ni dpag tshad stong*// ri rab rtsa ba'i 'khor sar 'dod// ri rab rmang gi shar nub rgyar// dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug yod// steng rgya stong phrag lnga bcu'o// dbyibs ni rwa lnga 'di'i rwa yang*// rwa 'gag zhes pa'i rwa ji bzhin// kun tu 'khor ba'i phyi phyi ring*/

ind+ra nī la padma dmar// chu shel karka ta margad// phyogs bzhi stong mdog srid du 'bum// de steng gyen du 'bum phrag gi /tshad ni gtsug tor gdong dang mgrin// de bas gling bzhi'i 'jig rten 'di// srid zheng 'bum phrag bzhi par mnyam// rlung phyir nam mkha' 'bum phrag gcig /de nas gzhan gyi mkha' rlung de// stong gsum kun la mtshungs par 'dod// gling bzhi rgya la rim pa bzhin// stong phrag bdun brgyad bcu dang dgu /bye brag lho gling dbus ma 'di'i// dbus nas bsil ri'i bar mnyam drug /yul drug tu bshad thob skal yin// bod li'i khyon la 'di med cing*// li yul nas phar stong phrag gsum// sham bha la yin 'dab brgyad dbyibs// re rer yul chen bcu gnyis re// de re bye ba phrag rer 'dod// stong ni de yi lte ba'i khyon// lhas brtsigs pho brang ka lā pa// bye ba phrag ni bcu gnyis grong*// tshangs pa'i drang srong rnams dang bcas// thub pa mchog gi grong khyer ro// phyi nang mu khyud gangs ris bskor// mu khyud rgya yang de la the// de nas rdo rje gdan par stong*// der ni rgya gar bod li yod// lte ba de nas lho yi mthar// stong phrag bzhi yang 'phags yul pa// tshul 'di gling dbyibs tshad dang mthun// de la bcud kyi gnas tshul ni// tshes bzang tshangs 'das dpal dang ni// dkar po'i bskal pa gzugs med gzugs// gtsug tor gdong pa'i tshad la'o// zad par mkha' rlung me chu sa// 'dod lha drug yang zad par ni// sgra gcan nyi zla'i 'bras mgrin par// de las sum cu rtsa gsum pa// ri rab rtser ni rnam rgyal dbus// blta na sdug gis de la bskor// phyogs bzhir tshal bzhi mtshams chos bzang*// yongs 'du a rmo nig ka'i rdo// ljongs dang nags tshal yid dga'i mthar// lcang lo can gyis kun nas bskor// de nyid lag na rdo rje'i grong*// cog lcags 'dra bar gnas pa yin// de tha mkha' la rgyal chen bzhi// rwa dang bsil ri'i 'byor thad du// rgyu skar dag gi go la te// 'bab 'dzeg dbang gis bgrod pa gnyis// nang gi gling drug longs spyod sa// rang lus 'od kyis bya ba byed// phyi gling las sa mi yi gnas// sa dkyil phyed gong phyed steng ma// lha min 'og klu 'og ma ni// gseg ma'i dmyal ba yi dwags kyang*// lhag ma'i dkyil 'khor phyed phyed la// bye ma 'dam chu mi bzad du// me dang mun pa mun pa che// phyi mar khab rtse'i dmyal ba 'ang*// phra rab phra mo skra nyi rdul// shi gnas sor rnams brgyad 'gyur sor// bcu gnyis mtho yin gnyis la khru// de bzhin gzhu 'dom de nyis stong*/

rgyang grags de bzhi dpag tshad do// srid gsum bskal pa'i tshe tshad la// bskal chen bzhi dang 'bring bcu drug /bskal chung drug la 'og re phri// srid pa'i rtse nas rgyal chen bar// mi ni nges med sa gnas gsum// bskal chung chu yi gnyis po 'bring*// mer gnas mchog yin lhag bskal chen// khab rtse 'jig rten sdud pa'i tshad// 'byung 'jug gnas rnams dbugs gcig yin// de drug chu srang de drug cu// chu tshod dbyug gu rnam grangs pa// drug cus zhag gcig sum cu zla// bcu gnyis lor longs de 'dra ba// bcu gnyis lo skor lnga lo rgan// de phyir rlung gis dus dang ni// zla bas phyogs gnyis rdul gyis ni// lho byang bgrod pa bzhag pa yin// lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa// seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa// gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya// rlung gi rang bzhin zlum por snang*// lhun por g.yas su zhag rer skor// drug ni pad 'dab lhag ma gzhu// lug dang bu mo bkar srang nya// dmar po sdig bum nag glang seng*// ser sbal 'khrig sdo gzhu chu srin// ljang kha stong phrag bdun cu lnga// lho byang du khyab rang rang tshad// rgyu skar dag gi rkang pa dgu /nyi zla lha yi gzhal med khang*// ri bo mchog la g.yon du bskor// de phyir 'gros gnyis myur dal lo// sgra gcan khyim phyed non pa gzugs// sbrul 'dra 'gros ni g.yas su'o// zla bas zla rer nyi mas ni// lo gcig ring la skor ba gcig /rgyu skar khyim la gzer btab bzhin// gza' rnams phan tshun rgyu ba ste// nyi ma lug gi khyim du zhugs// de tshe gling de'i nag pa'i zla// glang nas sa ga rim pa des// snron dang chu stod gro bzhin dang*// khrums stod tha skar smin drug dang*// mgo rgyal chu dbo zla ba 'khor// nag pa dpyid 'bring dbo ra pa// sa ga tha chung ji bzhin gzhan// dgun dbyar ra bar nyi ma zlog /dpyid ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa ste// shar gling dbus thad nyi ma sleb// nyi gung byang gling nyi ma nub// lho gling du shar nub nam dgung*// 'char nub snga phyi'i dbang gis na// dum bu sum brgya drug cu'i sar// zhag re nyi bzlog shes par bya// zlog pa 'gras kyi mthar thug yin// byang bgrod gdung byed bsil ri mnyam// gling dbus thad las nang mi 'ong*// lho bgrod de las stong phrag ni// bcu gcig gis dma' rtag gdong mnyam// rgya mtsho'i bzhi cha phar mi 'da'// nyi lam gsum 'bum bdun khri stong*// lnga 'o mnyam dus chu sa'i mtshams// rang rang gling 'dra 'di na dbyar// nub dpyid byang dgun shar na ston// nyi dag skar mar mda' dang ni// chu tshod dbang mig shar ba'i tshe// gnas 'di'i dbyar nyi zlog pa yin// de la skar mar drug dang ni// chu tshod zhe lnga sbyin pa'i tshe// ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa yin// de la gong bzhin sbyin pas dgun// de la gong bzhin sbyin pas dpyid// de la gong bzhin sbyin pas kyang*// dbyar zlog ri mo de kha 'byung*// zla ba'i 'gros kyis yud tsam dang*// nyi 'grong zhag gi lus la 'ang*// dbyar mnyam la sogs smyon pa'i gar// rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa las go la bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o//

// bri dang bgrang ba g.yas nas bya// bgod dang bsgyur ba g.yon nas byed// rkyang bgod ji tsam thob pa khyer// sbrags bgod 'og ma'i tshod dang sbyar// bgod byed mtha' yi thig les ni// ma mtha' 'gog cing bar gyis ni// rang gnas 'dzin la bgod nas med// sgyur byed mtha' yi thig le rnams// bsgyur bya'i gral mthar 'god pa yin// sgyur byed stong na bsgyur bya dbri// 'di ni grogs med thig le 'o// snon pa g.yas la 'brid pa g.yon// dgu gcig gcig dgu dgu rang yin// dgu gnyis gnyis dgu bco brgyad la// dgu gsum gsum dgu nyi shu bdun// dgu bzhi bzhi dgu sum cu drug /dgu lnga lnga dgu bzhi bcu lnga// dgu drug drug dgu lnga bcu bzhi// dgu bdun bdun dgu drug cu gsum// dgu brgyad brgyad dgu bdun cu gnyis// dgu dgu brgyad cu gya gcig go /brgyad gcig gcig brgyad brgyad rang yin// brgyad gnyis gnyis brgyad bcu drug la// brgyad gsum gsum brgyad nyi shu bzhi// brgyad bzhi bzhi brgyad sum cu gnyis// brgyad lnga lnga brgyad bzhi bcu tham// brgyad drug drug brgyad bzhi bcu brgyad// brgyad bdun bdun brgyad lnga bcu drug /brgyad brgyad drug cu re bzhi'o// bdun gcig gcig bdun bdun rang yin// bdun gnyis gnyis bdun bcu bzhi la// bdun gsum gsum bdun nyi shu gcig /bdun bzhi bzhi bdun nyi shu brgyad// bdun lnga lnga bdun sum cu lnga// bdun drug drug bdun bzhi bcu gnyis// bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o// drug gcig gcig drug drug rang yin// drug gnyis gnyis drug bcu gnyis la// drug gsum gsum drug bco brgyad do// drug bzhi bzhi drug nyi shu bzhi// drug lnga lnga drug sum cu tham// drug drug sum cu so drug go /lnga gcig gcig lnga lnga rang yin// lnga gnyis gnyis lnga bcu tham pa// lnga gsum gsum lnga bco lnga la// lnga bzhi bzhi lnga nyi shu tham// lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// bzhi gcig gcig bzhi bzhi rang yin/

bzhi gnyis gnyis bzhi brgyad yin la// bzhi gsum gsum bzhi bcu gnyis so// bzhi bzhi dag ni bcu drug go /gsum gcig gcig gsum gsum rang yin// gsum gnyis gnyis gsum drug yin la// gsum gsum dag la dgu zer ro// gnyis gcig gcig gnyis gnyis rang yin// gnyis gnyis dag la bzhi zhes grags// gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang*// sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams// rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya// ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang*// gtam dkris mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang*// spang steng deng 'dren mtha' snang dang*// rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang*// legs byin rtogs 'gro 'byin 'dul dang*// brgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang*// rnam 'byung stobs mig khyad yal yal// bgrang yas sdug yas shang shang zung*// grangs med pa ni mtha' ma yin// gzugs zla bse ru gcig gi ming*// lag mig zung phyogs 'khrig bgrod gnyis// 'jig rten yon tan me gsum mo// mtsho chu dus dang rig byed bzhi// 'byung ba mda' dad dbang po lnga// mtshams ro bro ba dus ni drug /thub ri drang srong gza' ni bdun// klu sbrul gdeng can ltos 'gro dang*// nor lha sred pa zhes pa brgyad// rtsa gter gza' bug srin po dgu /bcu la phyogs yin 'phrog byed drag /bde 'byung dbang phyug bcu gcig go /nyi ma khyim ni bcu gnyis yin// myos byed 'dod pa bcu gsum mo// yid dang ma nu srid bcu bzhi// tshes dang nyin zhag bco lnga 'o// mi bdag rgyal po bcu drug ste// nyes pa skyon ni bco brgyad do// rgyal ba nyer bzhi nyer lnga pa// de nyid nyer bdun skar ma'o// so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis te// 'di dag grangs brda'i rnam grangs so// rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang*// rab myos skyes bdag aṃ gi ra// dpal gdong dngos po na tshod ldan// 'dzin byed dbang phyug 'bru mang po// myos ldan rnam gnon khyu mchog dang*// sna tshogs nyi ma nyi sgrol byed// sa skyong mi bzad thams cad 'dul// kun 'dzin 'gal ba rnam 'gyur dang*// bong bu dga' ba rnam rgyal nyid// rgyal ba myos byed gdong ngan dang*// gser 'phyang rnam 'phyang sgyur byed dang*// kun ldan 'phar ba dge byed dang*// mdzes byed khro mo sna tshogs dbyig

/zil gnon spre'u phur bu dang*// zhi ba thun mong 'gal byed dang*// yongs 'dzin bag med kun dga' dang*// srin bu me dang dmar ser can// dus kyi pho nya don grub drag /blo ngan rnga chen khrag skyug pa// mig dmar khro bo zad pa'o// nyi ma zla ba mig dmar dang*// lhag pa phur bu pa sangs dang*// spen pa rnams ni res gza' bdun// sgra gcan dus me du mjug gsum// bsnan pas gza' ni rnam pa bcu// nyi ma nam so skyes zla ba// tha skar skyes mig bkra shis dang*// dmag dpon mchu skyes sa skyes dmar// 'khyog lhag lag dang lha mtshams skyes// zla skyes lha bla me bzhi skyes// sgra mkhan blon po pa sangs la// sbyin byed bla ma dkar po dang*// lha min blon spen nyi skyes dang*// zhi 'gro dal 'gro zhes rnam grangs// tha skar bra nye smin drug dang*// snar ma mgo lag nab so rgyal// skag mchu gre dbo me bzhi dang*// nag pa sa ri sa ga dang*// lha mtshams snon snubs chu stod dang*// chu smad gro bzhin mon dre dang*// mon gru khrums stod khrums smad dang*// nam gru rgyu skar nyi shu bdun// byi bzhin gro bzhin skar khongs mthun// so sor phye na nyer brgyad yod// tshes ni dga' ba bzang po dang*// rgyal stong rdzogs pa lan gsum gyis// phyogs re shes bya sbyor ba'i ming*// rnam sel mdza' bo tshe ldan dang*// skal bzang bzang po shin skrangs dang*// las bzangs 'dzin pa zug rngu skrangs// 'phel nges kan 'joms dga' rdo rje// grub pa shin ltung mchog can dang*// yongs 'joms zhi grub sgrub dge dkar// tshangs dbang khon 'dzin nyi shu bdun// byed pa gdab byis rigs can dang*// tir brdung khyim skyes tshong biṣṭi// shaṅku ni dang rkang bzhi klu// mi sdug bzhi ni thun mong min// zhes rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa las/

rtsis kyi sngon du 'gro ba bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// // tshes dang gza' dang skar ma dang*// sbyor byed yan lag lnga yin no// me mkha' rgya mtsho rnams la ni// rab byung la sogs 'das lo bsres// kla klo'i lor ni rab tu grub// lag pa gdengs can zla bas sbyang*// lhag ma nyi mas sgyur ba la// nag nya la sogs 'das zla bsre// gnas gnyis 'og ma chu bos bsgyur// de la mkha' mi zla bas bgo /lhag mar gnyis byung ngo thog lhag /thig byung phyi ma bshol zla yin// rnyed pa steng sbyin zla dag go /gnas gsum dbus ma so yi sgyur// 'og ma ros thob bar la sbyang*// steng 'og mig dang sum cu bsre// mkha' ros bgos lhag chu tshod yin// rnyed pa steng byin thub pas bgo /lhag ma gza' yi gnas su nges// gnas gnyis la ni nyi zla bsre// dus nyis bgos lhag cha shas gnas// nor la 'byung ba bsre bar bya// steng ma mig gis bsgyur la sbyin// klu lag gis bgos lhag ma ril// gnas gsum dbus ma drag pos bsgyur// 'og ma bu ga me yis bgo /rnyed par mig byin dbus ma sbyangs// mkha' ros bgos lhag chu tshod do// steng ma mig gis bsgyur ba la// rnyed pa sbyin la 'khor los bgo /lhag ma skar ma'i gnas su nges// gza' yi gnas su zla ba ste// chu tshod gnas su mig me sbyin// cha shas zla ba ril por mig /skar mar mig dang chu tshod du// drag po rab tu sbyin par bya// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis gzhi yin// gza' yi gnas su tshes grangs byin// de nyid chu tshod gnas nas sbyangs// slar yang ril por sbyin par bya// de la rgya mtsho zla bas bgo /rnyed pa mnyam dang mi mnyam las// snon 'bri mtshan nyid shes par bya// rnyed pa med na'ang mnyam pa yin// lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*// 'byung dang 'byung ba mda' rig byed// me dang lag pa ri bong can// bzlog pa dang bcas yid kyis gnas// zla ba dang ni bcu gsum mda'// mig dang nyi ma dag la phyogs// me dang drag por tshes zhes bya// rgya mtsho phyogs la bu ga gzugs// mda' dang bu gar lag pa mig

/dus dang klu la rgyal ba ste// thub pa la ni de nyid do// de ltar snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pa gzung*// rkang pa snga mas cha shas bsgyur// dus nyis bgos pas thob pa ni// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur la bgod// rnyed pa chu srang gnas su bzhag /lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na chu tshod 'og ma yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las kyang ni gcig phab la// mkha' ros bsgyur la chu srang gis// sbyang lhag gcig phab drug bsgyur dbugs// sbyangs pa'i lhag ma gzung byas te// gza' yi chu tshod man chad du// snon dang dbri bar bya ba yin// tshes grangs gang yin gnas gnyis su// byas te gong ma chu bos bsgyur// 'og ma mes thob steng la byin// thob na drug cus bgo bar bya// rnyed pa skar ma'i gnas su sbyin// lhag ma chu tshod du sbyin no// 'og gi lhag ma nyi shus bsgyur// chu srang du sbyin nyi bar yin// de nyid gnas gnyis bkod byas la// skar ma'i gnas nas drug dang ni// chu tshod gnas nas zhe lnga dor// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la dor// 'khor byed lhag na'ang dor bar bya// rgyu skar gnas ni mkha' ras bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'byung ba me dang zla bas bgo /rnyed pas nyi ma'i rkang pa gzung*// dus dang rgya mtsho zla ba ste// bzlog pa dang bcas ro yi gnas// gzugs dang mda' la ro yin te// mig dang rgya mtsho dag la phyogs// me la drag po zhes bya'o// de ltar snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pa gzung*// rkang pa snga mas lhag rnams bsgyur// sngar gyi bgod byed kyis thob pa// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur la bgo /'thob pa chu srang gnas su bzhag /lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs// nyi rkang mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na chu tshod 'og ma yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las gcig phab drug cus bsgyur// chu srang gis sbyangs lhag ma dag

/gcig phab drug bsgyur dbugs sbyangs lhag /gza' dang skar ma'i longs spyod du// byang bgrod la sbyin lho bgrod dor// de yis gza' nyi rnam par dag /nyi ma dag pa gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gi skar mar tshes grangs byin// tshes grangs logs bris drug gis bsgyur// de la gza' yi chu tshod bsre// thob na drug cus bgo bar bya// rnyed pas skar ma'i gnas nas sbyangs// lhag mas chu tshod sbyang bar bya// gza' yis chu srang dbugs kyis ni// skar ma'i chu srang dbugs sbyang bya// gza' dang zla nyi skar ma'i gnas// ri dang 'khor los bgo bar bya// lhag ma gza' dang rgyu skar gyi// rnam par dag pa mngon sum 'char// nyi zla bsres pa sbyor ba yin// tshes grangs mig bsgyur zla bas sbyangs// thub pas bgos lhag byed pa'o// skad cig bskal pa'i li'u tho// bde blag nyid du rtogs 'dod na// bskal pa'i li tho'i ri'u mig la// log gang nag zla'i nyi dhru 'am// gong gi dbo zla'i nyi dhru la// de la zhag grangs ci rigs pa'i// rtag longs byin lhag zhag gcig gi /longs spyod dag tu ma longs pa// gang de lo de'i spyi nor yin// gza' tshes dhru pa 'di nyid dang*// tshes mtshungs tshes gza'i rtag longs byin// gza' tshes spyi nor rags pa'ang thon// nyi ma'i spyi nor gang yin de// 'dod cha'i bar gsil gnas gsum bzhag /zla chu dus kyis rim bsgyur la// 'byung ba me zlas bgos lhag dor// thob pa 'dod cha nas gzung ste// rang rang 'khor los phud pa de// zla chu dus kyi rkang longs yin// gza' nyi'i spyi nor gnas drug bkod// lug dang bu mor zla ba ni// dbri zhing nya dang srang la sbyin// glang dang seng ge chu gter ni// dbri zhing bum pa sdig par sbyin// 'khrig pa dkar ṭar du dbri zhing*// chu srin gzhu la sbyin byas pas// gza' nyid spyi nor rnam par dag /gang zin tshes de'i phyi ma nas// spyi nor 'di dag nyid kyis so// de nas re'u mig gzung bya ste// gang rtsi zla ba'i nyi dhru la// gang rtsi tshes kyi rtag longs byin// de la nyi ma rags pas phri// bskal li'i nyi ma phyed dag dang*// mthun par gyur na zin pa yin// de ltar gzung ba'i bar 'og gi

/gza' dang nyi ma'i spyi nor de// lug sogs so so'i re'u mig /ma rdzogs bar du so so ba// gnas lngar stobs mtshungs byin pas 'grub// ril por tshes byin yid kyis bgo /rnyed nor mnyam dang mi mnyam lta// lhag mas cha shas re mig gzung*// ril cha'i re mig gang zin de// skabs de'i gza' tshes longs spyod la// nor mnyam snon zhing mi mnyam 'bring*// nyi dag gnas gnyis gcig la ni// zla tshes re mig byin pa la// gza' tshes longs spyod kyis sbyang bya// nyi zla bsres pa sbyor ba'o// tshes reng byed pa snga phyi ni// 'char ba ngan pa biṣṭi'i tshes// mtsho drag skyon dang de nyid phyi// klu tshes lag mig nyer dgu'i snga// tshes longs snga mas mkha' ro la// phri lhag nam langs gong du 'das// de dang da lta'i longs spyod gnyis// bsres la mig gis thob pa'i nor// biṣṭi rgyu ba'i yun tshad yin// biṣṭi phyi cha dag la ni// chad de da lta'i tshes longs phri// lhag ma nam langs nas gzung ste// rdzogs nas dbri byed tshad yun sdod// ma ldang tshe longs nam langs nas// de yi yun du spyod par byed// biṣṭi snga cha dag la ni// tshad des da lta'i tshes longs phyi// lhag ma nam langs nas gzung ste// de yi yun du spyod par byed// ma ldang gong gi tshes longs rdzogs// 'bring byed tshad yun sdod pa'o// des na blang dor shes par bya// lo bdag dang ni zla bdag gis// rtsis su bzhed pa'i tshul de ni// rgyud las 'byung ba 'di yin no// me mkha' rgya mtsho las brtsams pa'i// lo bdag la ni klu bsres la// gnas gnyis steng ma gang yin pa// mkha' mkha' chus bsgyur 'og mas dbri// lhag ma ri zla mas 'thob gza'// lhag ma mkha' ras bsgyur 'thob dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ras bsgyur 'thob srang*// lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs// gza' yi gnas su gnyis sbyin zhing*// chu tshod du ni sum cu byin// rang rang 'khor los steng du dril// longs spyod dang bcas snga lo 'das// de yi 'bras bu phyi lor 'phel// yang na snga lo'i nges pa la// gza' gcig dbyug tshes mda' me srang*// dbugs gcig ri zla me yi cha// zla me gzugs ni byin pas grub// zla bdag so sor rtogs bya'i phyir// lo bdag gnas gzhan bcu gnyis bkod// lug sogs khyim gyi mtshan ma bri// zla ba ri 'byung lug gi ni// gza' dang dbyug sogs rim bzhin sbyin// de bzhin du ni glang sogs la// rig byed me 'byung glang la'o// gzugs dang ri zla 'khrig pa ste// mtsho dang me 'byung karka ṭa// zla ba lag mig seng ge la// rig byed rgyal ba bu mo ste// dus dang zla dbang srang la'o// gzugs dang ri mtsho sdig pa la// rtse mo can dang me bdag gzhu// rgya mtsho ri me chu srin te// dus dang rig byed bum pa la// mkha' dang mig mda' nya la byin// gza' dang chu tshod rang rang gi

/'khor lo bgos lhag gza' sogs yin// de yi zla ba'i bdag po rtogs// rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa las lnga bsdus 'phros pa dang bcas pa bshad pa'i skabs te rab tu byed pa bzhi pa'o// // zla bar mig dang nyi ma bsre// mig gis bsgyur la nya la gcig /stong la gnyis ni sbyin par bya// mkha' ro rgya mtshos bgos pa yis// rnyed nor dor la lhag ma rnams// 'khor los bsgyur la bgo bar bya// rnyed pa skar ma'o lhag ma ni// mkha' ros bsgyur la bgo bar bya// rnyed pa chu tshod gnas su bzhag /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur la bgo /rnyed pa chu srang yin zhes bya// lhag ma drug gis bsgyur ba la// rnyed pa dbugs te bul pa yin// 'khor lo la sbyangs gdong yin la// de la 'khor lo phyed bsres pa// dus me'i longs spyod dag pa yin// nyin mtshan ring thung rtogs byas la// nya yi tshes 'khyud zla ba dang*// de yi sgra gcan gdong mjug gnyis// gang dang nye ba de bkod la// nyung gis mang la sbyang bar bya// gdong la zla bas sbyangs pa dang*// zla bar dus mes sbyangs pa'i tshe// skar ma'i gnas ni stongs pa dang*// chu tshod mkha' mda'i bar la 'dzin// zla bar gdong gis sbyangs pa dang*// dus me zla bas sbyangs pa'i tshe// skar gnas thig gyur dbyug gu ni// nga lnga man mthong lhag mi mthong*// nyer gsum tshun la ril po sgrib// de las lhag na 'byung ba yis// bgos pas thob pa'i nor la ni// mda' shar drug cha ma gtogs 'dzin// ro la sum gnyis ri la phyed// klu la sum cha bug drug cha// phyogs la brgyad cha tsam zhig 'dzin// drag por bco lnga chag gcig 'dzin// ril 'dzin chu tshod bcu gnyis yin// phyed la drug dang sum cha bzhi// de yi gzhan rnams rigs pas chod// dus ni res gza'i longs spyod du// dbyug drag chu srang nyi shu byin// de dag zad tshe mthong ba yin// de la nyin mo'i tshad kyis sbyangs// ma ldang gling gzhan 'dzin pa yin// gtong 'phro gling 'dir mthong ba'ang srid// lhag ma mtshan mo'i tshad dang sbyor// phyogs ni zla bas gdong sbyangs na// byang shar nas 'dzin nam phyed na'o// srod la byang nyin ma smad shar// gdong gis zla sbyangs shar lho nas// nam phyed na'o nam smad lho// srod la byang nye'i phyogs nas so// mjug mas zla phri byang shar nas// nam phyed na'o nam smad shar// srod la byang nye phan tshun mnyam// shar nas srod dbang nam smad med// nub kyi phyogs nas 'dzin mi srid// kha dog ril po 'dzin pa na// dmar nag gdong yin dmar skya mjug

/rgyu skar mgo lag snar mar gzung*// mkha' 'dra chung du 'dzin dus nag /phyed sngo sum gnyis khams de las// ches na dmar shas 'byung ba yin// nyi ma 'dzin pa'i man ngag ni// gnam stong nyi skar dag pa dang*// sgra gcan gdong mjug gang nye brtag /nyung gis mang la sbyang dgos pas// sgra gcan gdong gis nyi ma sbyang*// lhag ma skar ma thig le dang*// chu tshod bzhi bcu man la 'dzin// nyi mas gdong sbyangs skar gnas stongs// chu tshod brgyad kyi bar shar 'dzin// nyi mas mjug phri skar gnas stongs// chu tshod bzhi bcu'i bar la 'dzin// mjug mas nyi ma sbyangs pa na// skar stongs chu tshod lnga tshun 'dzin// cha shas ji tsam 'dzin pa ni// gdong mjug nyi mas sbyangs pa'i lhag /lngas bgos thig le'am gcig rnyed na// ril por 'dzin pa nyid yin no// rnyed pa gnyis nas bdun gyi bar// mi sgrib pa yi cha shas ni// re rer 'phel ba brgyad thob tshe// sum cha gcig ni sgrib par snang*// gdong la nyi mas sbyangs pa dang*// nyi mar dus mes sbyangs pa yi// cha shas sgrib tshul rigs pas chod// dus ni tshes kyi longs spyod la// chu tshod bcu gcig srang nyi shu// byin zad mtshams 'dzin nyin mtshan dpag /mtshan mo'i srod 'dzin mi mthong zhing*// tshes longs mang tshe shas cher 'dzin// 'jig rten tshes gcig 'dir mthong srid// phyogs ni gdong la nyis sbyangs na// bden bral nyin phyed phyed gong lho// phyed 'og nub tu nye nas so// nyi mar gdong sbyangs nub byang nas// nyin phyed na'o phyed gong nub// phyed 'og byang nye'i phyogs nas so// mjug mas 'dzin pa gdong dang mtshungs// yang na lho bgrod rlung phyogs dang*// byang bgrod srin po'i kha dog ni// zla 'dra shar nub ri bo'i dpangs// tshes kyi lhag chad zhib mor brtag /ces rtsis kyi lag len mdo tsam brjod pa dus kyi 'khor lo gsal bar byed pa las sgra gcan dang gza' 'dzin bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa lnga pa'o//

// zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur// de la so so'i nyin zhag bsre// de nyid gnas gsum bzhag pa yi// 'og ma ri mkha' ri yi bgo /rnyed pa bar mar bsres pa la// rgya mtsho ro yis rnyed pa yis// steng la sbyangs pa mi gsal zhag /de nyid gnas gnyis bzhag pa yi// 'og ma thub pas bgos lhag dang*// tshes de'i gza' dang mthun nam blta// mi mthun gyur na gcig la sogs// snon 'brid byas la mthun par bya// 'di las gzhan du smra ba 'khrul// mthun par byas pa gsal ba'i zhag /gza' lnga spyi yi longs spyod do// de nas so so'i longs spyod ni// bkra shis la ni gsal zhag la// ri dang mtshams dang zla ba bsre// lhag pa'i gsal zhag brgya yis bsgyur// me dang nyi ma ri yis sbyangs// phur bu mkha' mkha' ro mig 'brid// dkar po bcus bsgyur chu nor dbrog /spen pa mkha' mig nor chu dbrog /de nas rang rang dkyil 'khor gyis// bgo bar bya'o dkyil 'khor ni// bkra shis la ni ri klu ro// lhag pa'i ri bug ri klu'o// bla ma'i so me rgya mtsho ste// sbyin byed bla ma'i ri rgyal mig /dal ba'i ro dus ri mkha' zla// rnyed nor dor nas lhag ma rnams// skar mas bsgyur la rang rang gi /dkyil 'khor rnams kyis bgos thob nor// skar ma'o lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur// rnyed pa chu tshod lhag ma rnams// mkha' ros bsgyur la rnyed pa srang*// lhag ma ros bsgyur rnyed pa dbugs// drag gza'i dal ba bar pa yin// zhi gza'i rkang 'dzin longs spyod do// drag gza'i dal ba bar pa dang*// zhi gzi'i nyi ma bar ba dag /gnas gnyis byas pa'i phyogs gcig la// rang rang skyes khyim sbyang bar bya// phyed bcas dgu sbyangs bkra shis la// phyed bcas mi bdag zla ba'i bu// bla ma la ni nyi mas sbyangs// dkar po la ni rgyu skar drug /nyi ma'i bu la nyes pa dor// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la dor// 'khor phyed lhag na'ang dor bar bya// dor ma dor gyi rim min rim// dal bar snon 'brid shes par bya// lhag ma'i skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'byung ba me dang zla bas mgo

/thob pas rang rang dal rkang gzung*// bkra shis de nyid nyes pa ri// zla skyes bcu ri me rnams so// sgra mkhan bde byed bu ga me// dkar po mda' chu ri bong can// mig lag tshes mtshams spen pa ste// de las zlog pa phyi rkang ngo*// snga phyir zos dang ma zos sdom// ma zos sdun mas longs spyod bsgyur// 'byung ba me zlas bgos pa'i nor// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// chu srang sbyin la bgos thob srang*// lhag ma ros bsgyur dbugs bsres la// bgos thob dbugs su shes par bya// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis pa bsre bar bya// 'das nas yang dag rgyu ba yi// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las gcig phab drug cus bsgyur// srang gis sbyangs lhag gcig phab la// ros bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs lhag rnams// phyogs gcig la ni sbyin dor bya// de yi ngal ba dag par 'gyur// so so'i ngal dgag nas gnyis bzhag /drag gza'i gcig gis nye bar sbyangs// zhi gza'i rkang 'dzin longs spyod la// dal ba dag pas sbyang bar bya// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la dor// bsnan pa yod dam med kyang rung*// 'khor phyed lhag na'ang dor bar bya// dor na rim min ma dor rim// lhag mas myur ba'i rkang pa gzung*// sa skyes rgyal ba me mig gsum// gzugs mig rnam gnyis skyon chas drag /me 'o rtsa bar dbang phyug dang*// sbrul me mkha' klu me 'byung ngo*// zla skyes mi bdag mi bdag tshes// shed bu myos byed bde byed ri// 'byung mkha' rtsa bar mtsho dbang phyug /mkha' mig nor lag chu me'o// sgra mkhan phyogs phyogs bu ga sbrul// dus dus 'khrig pa 'od dkar can// rtsa bar me dang dus bu ga /drag po mi bdag thub pa'o// sbyin byed bla ma'i de nyid gsum// rgyal ba gnyis dang lag mig gnyis// skyon tshes brgyad dang rtsa bar ro// mkha' me srin bug mi ri 'o// dal bus bgrod pa'i dus mda' 'byung*// rig byed chu bo mig lag mkha'// rtsa bar mig dang rig byed 'byung*// dus dang klu dang yon tan no// de ltar rim pa lugs 'byung dang*// rim min rkang pa lugs bzlog 'dzin// snga phyir zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang gzung sngun mas longs spyod bsgyur// mkha' ros rnyed pa dbyug gu'o// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// chu srang bsres la mkha' ros 'thob// chu srang lhag ma ros bsgyur la// dbugs bsres drug cus thob pa dbugs// rim pa'i phyi rkang mtha' ma dang*// rim min snga rkang dang po la// mkha' me bgos pa khyad par yin// snga phyir byin dor sngar bzhin bya// rang rang dal ba dag pa la// myur bar rim snon rim min dbri// gal te dbri bya nyung ba na// dbri byas dbri byed dbri bar bya// de yis myur ba dag par 'gyur// ma dor ma rgal myur ba shar// brgal la ma dor dal ba lho// dor la ma rgal 'khyog po nub// brgal dor 'byung 'gros byang du blta// rtsis kyi lag len
